Pre-FEED Study 2 DE-FE0031937 / 0001 1.0 Abstract Dastur International Inc. has prepared a comprehensive DOE-funded Pre-front-end engineering design (Pre- FEED) study to capture up to 2.8 mtpa of CO from the available Blast Furnace (BF) gases at the Burns Harbor 2 steel plant operated by Cleveland Cliffs in Burns Harbor, Indiana.
